description: Dept. of Trade & Investment Policy - Special Commodity levy on fats and oil (Margarine) valid for period of 06 months commending from 27.06.2020 - Reserved
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains a ministerial order that modifies existing levy rates on specific commodities (vegetable fats and oils, margarine), which constitutes a regulatory action. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa by name and title, the core content is about legal/regulatory changes to commodity levies rather than government personnel matters or detailed portfolio descriptions. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
